title: [IMP-11] Set up model schedules and physical build events
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-11

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-11

Title
Set up model schedules and physical build events

Category
Fields and forms

Objective
Give model leads one schedule for related PPAPs while keeping physical builds distinct.

Detailed scope
Add Model Change, Model Date and Build Event fields/forms plus the three PPAP model/schedule controls. Enforce one phase-by-stage date per model, separate inclusive event start/end dates and one governing model/stage per model-change PPAP.

Deliverable
Model schedule/event forms and PPAP model-connection controls.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-02 — Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-02 provides the seven governed lists and operating-policy fields/default entries.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: the record/date controls and uniqueness rules can proceed; final phase/stage choices wait for controlled SIA values.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Model Change.Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Designated model lead; fixed after first related PPAP Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Unique model/program code; not ECS number.

PPAP Model Change.Name
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Designated model lead; audited. Field/control lifecycle: Display label; not a schedule key.

PPAP Model Change.Model Lead
Create a link to Employee, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Designated schedule administrator. Field/control lifecycle: Current designated lead maintains date matrix/build events; does not inherit ownership of linked PPAP.

PPAP Model Change.Active?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE. Who can use it and when: Schedule administrator. Field/control lifecycle: FALSE blocks new connections; current PPAP and published historical context retained.

PPAP Model Date.Model Change
Create a link to PPAP Model Change, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Model Change.Dates. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Model lead or schedule administrator. Field/control lifecycle: Unique Model Change+Phase+Manufacturing Stage; update triggers connected-open-work recalculation.

PPAP Model Date.Phase
Create a link to PPAP Schedule Phase, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Model lead; active values for new row; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Freeze identity once referenced by issued work; changing key means a deliberate new row.

PPAP Model Date.Manufacturing Stage
Create a link to PPAP Manufacturing Stage, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Model lead; active values for new row; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: One cell per governed stage; key fixed once used.

PPAP Model Date.Planned Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Model lead or schedule administrator; audited. Field/control lifecycle: Save handler watches Planned Date only, queues recalculation for open connected elements with matching phase/stage; no closed history rewrite.

PPAP Model Date.Change Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Model lead; required when Planned Date changes; otherwise retain read only. Field/control lifecycle: Native audit preserves old/new date, reason, actor/time; metadata-only handler changes must not recurse.

PPAP Build Event.Model Change
Create a link to PPAP Model Change, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Model Change.Build Events. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Model lead or schedule administrator. Field/control lifecycle: Physical event belongs to exactly one model; not a phase-matrix cell.

PPAP Build Event.Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Model lead; stable after downstream use. Field/control lifecycle: Unique within Model Change.

PPAP Build Event.Name
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Model lead. Field/control lifecycle: Display label.

PPAP Build Event.Manufacturing Stage
Create a link to PPAP Manufacturing Stage, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Model lead; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Used for pilot context and navigation, not substitute for date-matrix phase.

PPAP Build Event.Start Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Model lead; audited. Field/control lifecycle: Inclusive physical-event start; must be <= End Date. Changes notify downstream pilot adapter, not PPAP date calculations unless matrix separately changes.

PPAP Build Event.End Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Model lead; audited. Field/control lifecycle: Inclusive physical-event end; must be >= Start Date; same-day event uses equal values; no inferred duration rule.

PPAP.Model Change
Create a link to PPAP Model Change, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Model Change.PPAPs. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; required when Type.Code=NEW_MODEL; optional for explicit connected other types. Field/control lifecycle: Changing Type away from NEW_MODEL does not silently clear populated context: Draft user confirms retention or clears all model fields together; fixed context after Issue.

PPAP.Manufacturing Stage
Create a link to PPAP Manufacturing Stage, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; required when Model Change populated; hidden and NULL when no Model Change; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Draft context clearing clears stage after warning; issued context locked.

PPAP.Schedule Connected?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE when Model Change selected; FALSE otherwise. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer may Disconnect/Reconnect while open with warning and reason; FALSE forced if Model Change NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Schedule recalculation handler operates only when TRUE; manual dates persist disconnected.

PPAP Model Change.PPAPs
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP.Model Change; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Model Change.Dates
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Model Date.Model Change; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Model Change.Build Events
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Build Event.Model Change; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Configure one Model Date per Model Change+Phase+Manufacturing Stage. Require a reason when Planned Date changes. Give the designated Model Lead/schedule administrator ordinary date maintenance; the shared security assignment provides record grants.
2. Configure physical Build Event Start Date and End Date as inclusive dates; require Start Date<=End Date, with equal values for a same-day event. Do not use a build event as a phase-matrix cell.
3. Require Model Change when PPAP Type.Code=NEW_MODEL and Manufacturing Stage whenever Model Change is populated. If no Model Change, keep stage NULL/hidden and force Schedule Connected?=FALSE. In Draft, clearing model context warns and clears related stage/connection together; issued context is locked.

How to check the result
• Duplicate model/phase/stage cells and an event ending before it starts are rejected.
• A NEW_MODEL PPAP cannot be prepared without one model/stage; running/process changes may retain independent dates.

Information needed for this task
IN-01: Supply approved schedule phases and manufacturing stages; field/form structure and date-range rules can proceed before those entries arrive.

Supplied input context
• IN-01 — Client PPAP library and procedure: The client has been asked for the controlled SIA PPAP spreadsheet, procedure, IntelliQuest requirements/questions and template/classification matrix. They have not yet been supplied. Their exact content, protection rules, routing, dates and approved category/phase/stage/exception values are needed to complete the affected configuration; Objects and known controls can proceed.

Specification references
